title: Sondine helper event
description: One JSON line sent by sondine-audio to core, protocol 7.

ReadyEvent.description: Reply to `hello`: the helper speaks this protocol version.

RequestId.description: Client-chosen id of a control message, unique per connection; echoed as `replyTo`.

ShortText.description: Human-readable text without control characters, 1 to 256 characters.

AckEvent.description: Terminal success reply to every control message except `hello`.

replyTo.description: Id of the control message this event answers; absent on spontaneous events.

PermissionsEvent.description: Current microphone and system-audio permission state; sent on change.

PermissionState.description: Permission status and how it was learned. Stream health is reported per track, never here.

PermissionStatus.description: Permission state. `granted-verified` only after the first non-zero sample; silence never proves denial.

PermissionEvidence.description: How the status was learned: the public authorization API, the TCC preflight, the first non-zero sample, or not checked yet.

replyTo.description: Id of the control message this event answers; absent on spontaneous events.

DevicesEvent.description: The complete device list; sent on change.

anyOf.description: Current data source code, for example `ispk` (built-in speakers) or `hdpn` (headphones).

loopback.description: A known loopback or virtual device that carries system audio; never a microphone candidate.

FourCharCode.description: Core Audio four-character code as text, for example `bltn` or `usb `.

SampleRate.description: Sample rate in Hz (nominal or measured).

replyTo.description: Id of the control message this event answers; absent on spontaneous events.

ProcessesEvent.description: The complete list of Core Audio process objects with their mapping; sent on change.

anyOf.description: Track that captures this process: `app:<bundleID>` or `system:other`; null when excluded.
Why the process is in no tap: one of Sondine's own, or an app the user excluded.

AudioProcess.description: One Core Audio process object. A process incarnation is (pid, startWallNs).

ClockValue.description: Non-negative 64-bit integer written as a decimal string without leading zeros, at most 2^63 - 1. Decoded to bigint in TypeScript.

BundleId.description: Bundle identifier of an app or daemon.

AppIdentity.description: The app a process belongs to.

viaTerminal.description: A command-line process resolved to its terminal.

ProcessMapping.description: Evidence and confidence of a process-to-app mapping.

MappingEvidence.description: How a process object was mapped to an app.

replyTo.description: Id of the control message this event answers; absent on spontaneous events.

anyOf.description: Rate measured as frames ÷ Δhost time; null until measured.

TrackOpenEvent.description: A track run starts. Sample index 0 is the run's first sample.

Epoch.description: Capture epoch, increasing within one helper session. Each track run starts a new epoch, and so does a rate or format change inside a run; one event (wake, coreaudiod restart) may start the same epoch for several tracks.

ClockPoint.description: An instant on the helper's clocks: host ticks (mach_absolute_time, stops in sleep) and continuous nanoseconds (mach_continuous_time converted with the timebase, runs in sleep). Ordering and durations use continuousNs.

ClockAnchor.description: Anchor triple read together: host ticks, continuous nanoseconds, and wall-clock nanoseconds since the Unix epoch. Wall time is for display only.

AudioFormat.description: Spool sample format: 16 kHz mono signed 16-bit little-endian PCM.

StreamState.description: Health of a track's stream, independent of permission: waiting for the first IO cycle, delivering, no IO cycle for over 2 s, or flagged by the zero watchdog.

InputSelection.description: Why this microphone is open: the user's pin, the device a call app is using, or the allowlisted default input.

AppSource.description: A private process tap on every process object of one app.

SystemSource.description: The global tap: everything not on an app track, minus excluded processes.

replyTo.description: Id of the control message this event answers; absent on spontaneous events.

sampleIndex.description: Run sample index where the change applies.

anyOf.description: Rate measured as frames ÷ Δhost time; null until measured.

TrackUpdateEvent.description: A run's state changed. A rate or format change starts a new epoch at `sampleIndex`.

SampleIndex.description: Index of a 16 kHz sample since the start of its track run. Samples lost in gaps are counted, so the index tracks time.

replyTo.description: Id of the control message this event answers; absent on spontaneous events.

endSample.description: Samples in the run, gaps included.

TrackCloseEvent.description: A track run ended. Its spool files are complete once this event is sent.

TrackEndReason.description: Why a track run ended. `held`: a private zone holds capture (ADR 029); `paused` is only the user's pause.

replyTo.description: Id of the control message this event answers; absent on spontaneous events.

RegionOpenEvent.description: The VAD opened a speech region; it stays provisional until `region.close`.

replyTo.description: Id of the control message this event answers; absent on spontaneous events.

startSample.description: Run sample index where speech starts, without pre-roll.

endSample.description: Run sample index after the last speech sample, without post-roll; > startSample.

voicedSamples.description: Samples the VAD heard as speech between the bounds, which also hold pauses shorter than the minimum silence; <= endSample - startSample. Absent from manifests written before it existed.

foreground.description: The apps in front while it lasted, in order, inside the region and apart; a stretch with no app (none, the screen locked, an app the user excluded) has no span.

RegionCloseEvent.description: A speech region closed; the same span is written as a `region` manifest record (without `foreground`).

Count.description: Non-negative integer within the exact range of a double (2^53 - 1).

SpeechProbability.description: Mean and maximum VAD speech probability over an interval; max >= mean.

LevelStats.description: Mean and peak level over an interval; peak >= mean.

Dbfs.description: Level in dBFS: 10·log10 of mean power with full scale at 0, clamped to -120.

name.description: The app's name, else its bundle ID.

endSample.description: After the span's last sample; > startSample.

ForegroundSpan.description: The app in front on the Mac over part of a speech region, in run samples (ADR 022): NSWorkspace's frontmost application, never a window or what is on screen.

replyTo.description: Id of the control message this event answers; absent on spontaneous events.

file.description: PCM file relative to the spool root.

seq.description: Commit number within the PCM file, starting at 0.

committedOffset.description: Durable byte length of the PCM file after this commit. The block is [committedOffset - sampleCount × 2, committedOffset).

sampleIndex.description: Run sample index of the block's first sample.

crc32.description: CRC-32/ISO-HDLC (as zlib's crc32) of the block's bytes.

at.description: Clock of the block's first sample.

gaps.description: Gaps recorded since the previous commit of this run, in order, all before sampleIndex.

CommitEvent.description: A spool block became durable: the PCM bytes and the manifest record were both fsynced.

SpoolPath.description: Path of a spool file relative to the spool root, `/`-separated; no segment starts with a dot.

GapSpan.description: Samples [fromSample, toSample) of a run that have no stored bytes; toSample > fromSample.

GapReason.description: Why samples have no stored bytes.

replyTo.description: Id of the control message this event answers; absent on spontaneous events.

ActivityEvent.description: IO activity and attribution from `at` on; sent on change, debounced 500 ms.

RunningProcess.description: A process object with IO running.

candidateObjectIds.description: Process objects with output running in this track's scope.

TrackAttribution.description: Who the audio on an app or system track belongs to from `at` on. App tracks are `exact`; `system:other` is `single-active` (one app, all its process objects, or one process without an app) or `ambiguous`.

AttributionConfidence.description: How audio on a track is attributed to an app: its own tap, the only app (or the only process without one) with output running, or unknown.

replyTo.description: Id of the control message this event answers; absent on spontaneous events.

CallEvent.description: A call app, a call daemon, or a browser started or stopped using a microphone.

replyTo.description: Id of the control message this event answers; absent on spontaneous events.

ListenEvent.description: An app other than a call started or stopped listening to a microphone: a dictation app, a browser page, or the system's speech recognition (`speech`).

replyTo.description: Id of the control message this event answers; absent on spontaneous events.

CallSeenEvent.description: A call the helper sees, paused or not (ADR 036): a call app, a call daemon, or a browser playing sound started or stopped using a microphone. Never for Sondine's own or an excluded app; never a call span. One call id per active span; snapshots replay the active ones.

replyTo.description: Id of the control message this event answers; absent on spontaneous events.

screenAway.description: The screen is locked, the screen saver runs, or the displays sleep.

networks.description: Keyed hashes of the networks the Mac is on now, sorted; empty until a config brings a network key, or when none is readable.

SituationEvent.description: What the Mac's situation is, for core's zones: whether the screen is away, and the networks it is on. Sent on change and replayed in snapshots.

NetworkHash.description: A network the Mac is on, as the first 16 bytes of HMAC-SHA256(networkKey, NetworkSignature) in lowercase hex (ADR 029). The raw signature never travels.

replyTo.description: Id of the control message this event answers; absent on spontaneous events.

HoldsEvent.description: Every hold active now, lifted ones included; sent on change and replayed in snapshots. `ready.paused` stays the user's pause: a hold never changes it.

window.description: Index of the window in `holds.schedule`, for `schedule`.

HoldOccurrence.description: One occurrence of a hold: from its trigger's start to its end (the call or listen and 10 s, the window's end, leaving the network, the screen back). Sleep, wake and a reconnect do not end it. A lifted occurrence holds nothing until it ends; the next one has a new id.

HoldReason.description: What holds capture: an excluded app in a call or listening (`app`), a call (`calls`), the screen away, hours (`schedule`), or a network.

HoldScope.description: What a hold stops: everything, or the microphone only (an excluded app's call or listen).

WallMs.description: Wall-clock milliseconds since the Unix epoch; display and calendar only.

replyTo.description: Id of the control message this event answers; absent on spontaneous events.

ClockEvent.description: A fresh anchor triple, every 60 s and on wake; used by the live view only (manifests carry their own anchors).

replyTo.description: Id of the control message this event answers; absent on spontaneous events.

start.description: When the first frame's first sample was played into the tap.

levels.description: One level per 10 ms frame, in tenths of a dBFS: -1200 (digital silence) to 0.

SelfEnvelopeEvent.description: The private `self:playback` reference (ADR 035): the 10 ms energy of what Sondine itself plays, captured by a tap on its own processes while they run output, and nothing else (no PCM is stored, nothing is transcribed). Frames are contiguous from `start`; a gap starts a new event. Core keeps them in memory only, to tell echo of a playback from someone speaking over it. Never replayed in snapshots: `replyTo` is never set.

replyTo.description: Id of the control message this event answers; absent on spontaneous events.

cpuNs.description: User and system CPU time in the window.

wakeups.description: Idle and interrupt wakeups in the window.

HealthEvent.description: Histograms and counters for the window that ends at `at`; every 60 s by default.

zeroRunMs.description: Longest run of exact zeros in the window.

ringHighWaterMs.description: Fullest the capture ring got, in audio ms.

TrackHealth.description: Stream health of one open run over the window.

StageHistogram.description: Durations of one stage over the window, in nanoseconds. With count 0 every value is 0; otherwise p50 <= p95 <= max <= sum.

HealthStage.description: A helper stage measured with a fixed-bucket histogram; `tap-start` runs from the decision to start a tap to its first block.

replyTo.description: Id of the control message this event answers; absent on spontaneous events.

WarningCode.description: Open set of dotted warning codes, for example `transport.unknown` or `pcm.overflow`.

Message.description: Diagnostic text for logs, one line, 1 to 1024 characters.

replyTo.description: Id of the control message this event answers; absent on spontaneous events.

ErrorEvent.description: A failure. With `replyTo` it is the terminal reply to that control message. `fatal` means the helper exits after sending it.

ErrorCode.description: Closed set of error codes core acts on.
